name: Overnight
desc:
🎈 Welcome to Overnight! In this brand new (in 2019) STORY GAME, you're invited, in a group of 2-12, to spend the night 💤 at the new kid's house. With his parents out of town for the weekend, there's nothing that could possibly get in the way of your party... or is there?

🐻 Having trouble surviving? Consider purchasing the "Safety Bear" or "Running Shoes" gamepasses!

👍 If you enjoyed the game and want another, leave a like!

☠️ WARNING: This game contains some scary content and flashing lights!
